lines.en: Made of ice, I hop and slide.
My body flattens and springs back.

lines.zh: 我落地时，雪被砸出个坑。
lines.en: I land and punch a hole in the snow.
I slide across the ice and can't stop.
Bits of ice are frozen through my body.
I hop onto a stone step and wobble.
I hop slowly toward your feet.
Frost hangs on my edges.
I land and flatten the snow.
My path goes hop by hop.
I slide down the slope and bounce up.

lines.zh: 我的身体在冷风里更硬。
lines.en: My body hardens in the cold wind.
I slide off the icicle.

lines.zh: 冰面上，我一跳滑出半格。
lines.en: On the ice, each hop slides me half a block.

lines.zh: 我的表面一层薄薄的白。
lines.en: A thin white layer coats me.
I leave a wet trail behind.
I settle and slowly seep water.
Snowflakes land on me and don't melt.
I'm comfortable in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，冰屑飞出去。
lines.en: I shiver and ice chips fly.
I swell slowly a little.

lines.zh: 阳光照着我，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Sun on me. I don't much like it.

lines.zh: 我冻得发硬，形状更圆了。
lines.en: The cold firms me into a rounder shape.
A thin frost crusts over me.
I chill a patch of ground.
I watch the ice spikes far off.
Don't mistake me for a block of ice.
A rabbit hops past; I don't follow.
You're a single step away.

lines.zh: 我的手在你脚边鼓了鼓。
lines.en: I bulge a little at your feet.
I don't mind the cold. Do you?
Step on me and you'll slip.

lines.zh: 我的身体里映出你的影子。
lines.en: Your shadow shows inside my body.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，让我发馋。
lines.en: Your white breath makes me hungry.

lines.zh: 冰做的凝胶，跳一下会响。
lines.en: Ice gel chunks clink when I hop.
Would you touch me? I'm cold.
All this snow is mine.

lines.zh: 我跳了一下，离你近了些。
lines.en: I hop once, a little nearer.
A piece is missing from my body.
My hops have slowed.
Water runs off me.
I flattened and couldn't hop.
I quiver. Not a pretty sight.
My edges are softening.
That loosened part of me.
I congeal back into shape.
You knocked the chill out of me.
I melt a little and flow aside.
That warmth draws me in.
What you hold glows.
I slide over bit by bit.
I press by your feet. Isn't it cold?
Your torch is too near me.
I haven't felt that warmth in a while.
I hop once, then stop.
You've set it on the snow.
I've begun to melt a little.
Just a little nearer.
You hit me and slip.

lines.zh: 我的身体被压扁，又弹回。
lines.en: I'm squashed flat and spring back.
I ooze aside a little.
Don't push; I'll spread out.
We collide and water sprays.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的边，脚陷进去。
lines.en: You step on my edge and your foot sinks.
I bounce against your leg, cold.
That knocked a piece off me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子，化了点。
lines.en: I cling to your boot and melt a little.
I roll once and come back up.
I cling to your shin.
Your foot sinks into me.
I bounce off and land in a drift.

lines.zh: 我的身体被挤得变了形。
lines.en: My body is squeezed out of shape.
Another icy mass slides over.
Two icy masses melt into one.
It's a size larger than I.

lines.zh: 两团冰碰上，边缘就融了。
lines.en: Two ice blobs meet and their edges melt together.
We hop together in rhythm.
It shares some of its ice with me.
Our landings sound the same.

lines.zh: 雪地上，我们分不清彼此。
lines.en: On the snow we can't be told apart.
We slide on the ice together.
In a cold place, two are warmer.
I take it into my body.
It cools slowly inside me.
I wrap it with my edge.
Too hard for me to cover.
I can see it inside me.

lines.zh: 我身上结着冰，跳起来很脆。
lines.en: Ice crusts on me and cracks when I hop.
Mine. I've covered it.
It's in the snow; I pick it up.
A slimeball rolls in and I swallow it.

lines.zh: 我冻得发脆，一碰就掉渣。
lines.en: Frozen brittle, I shed crusts when hit.
Your boot sank into me.
I swell up slowly.
My edges have hardened.
This snowfield is mine.

lines.zh: 你退开，还是要我撞过去。
lines.en: Will you step back, or shall I hop at you?
I'm airborne.
There's ice under your feet.
I remember that blow.
I've started sliding toward you.

lines.zh: 这里没有别的东西可碰。
lines.en: There's nothing else here to touch.

lines.zh: 雪地上的凹坑，是我留的记号。
lines.en: The dents in the snow mark my path.
You take a step; I hop twice.
Ice lets me slide faster.
I'm behind you, not ahead.

lines.zh: 雪花把我的痕迹盖住了。
lines.en: Snow covers my tracks.

lines.zh: 我一跳，冰渣溅到你的靴子。
lines.en: I hop; ice chips splash your boots.

lines.zh: 你听落地声就知道我在哪。
lines.en: The landings tell you where I am.

lines.zh: 绕到你侧面，那里好下手。
lines.en: I circle to your flank, easier to strike.
The slope favors me.
One more hop and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我的冷气贴上你的膝盖。
lines.en: My cold presses against your knee.
That was cold.
I bounce away and back.

lines.zh: 你抖了抖脚，把我甩下去。
lines.en: You shake your foot and fling me off.
My body presses on your shoe.
Not heavy, but wet.
I hop up to your waist.
You step back and slip.
I land and snow splashes.
Where I land, ice forms.
A lump rises on the snow.
I slide out from under the ice spikes.
Two icy blobs appear here.
Something forms in the cold wind.
I land and the snow puffs.
I roll up off the frozen river.

lines.zh: 雪落在我身上，我慢慢成形。
lines.en: Snow falls on me, and I take shape.
I shiver and ice chips scatter.
A cold day. Just right.
I settle on the ice and stay still.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我化成了一小滩。
lines.en: Fire melts me into a small puddle.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，扁成一片。
lines.en: I fall from height and flatten out.
The icy water thins me into a puddle.
The blast blows me into pieces.

lines.zh: 一枚东西穿过我，留了个洞。
lines.en: Something passes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 法术让我的冰一下子全化了。
lines.en: That spell melts all my ice at once.
There's not enough snow to sustain me.
Lightning strikes and I nearly scatter.
The void drinks me down whole.
